name: Sable Fix Core 1.3.1
body:
## v1.3.1 — Network Fixes 🩹

- 🔌 **Frame overflow fix** — PanelData packets on huge archives could approach the 1 MB payload limit, silently dropping the connection (the infamous "network channel acting up"). Send-side hard truncation now caps files/UUIDs/logs at a safe size.
- ⚡ **Scan 7.3× faster** — per-pointer 4-byte reads (900 syscalls/file) replaced with sorted batched segment reads. 9.6 GB archive scans drop from ~26 s to ~3.5 s; the panel no longer spins on "scanning" for ages.
- 🤝 **Protocol version "2"** — client/server version mismatch is now rejected at **handshake** with a clear message, instead of runtime channel failures that looked like random dropouts.

⚠️ **Both sides must update to 1.3.1 together** (protocol v2 ≠ v1 handshake will be rejected — that is the new clear-error behavior working as intended).

## 中文

- 🔌 **帧超限修复** —— 超大存档的面板数据包逼近 1MB 载荷上限导致静默断连（"网络通道抽风"）。发送侧硬截断，彻底杜绝。
- ⚡ **扫描提速 7.3 倍** —— 逐指针读改为排序分段批读。9.6GB 存档从约 26 秒降到约 3.5 秒。
- 🤝 **协议版本号升至 v2** —— 版本不匹配在握手期就被明确拒绝，不再运行期"抽风"。

⚠️ **双端必须同时更新到 1.3.1**（协议 v2 与 v1 握手会被拒——这正是新报错机制在正常工作）。
